title: security: rbac-v2 + KMS region pinning audit hardening and audit log enrichment
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Hardening RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region residency and enriching audit logs with KMS metadata. Backwards-compatible for most customers; operators with custom RBAC policies should review migration notes.
description: This PR hardens RBAC v2 enforcement around KMS key residency and improves audit logging for KMS operations. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require strict enforcement of KMS region pinning to prevent accidental cross-region key usage, and security teams require richer audit fields to demonstrate compliance. Changes include: 1) RBAC policy engine extension to support explicit kms_region residency constraints and enforcement mode toggles (audit|enforce), 2) policy migration helper that flags existing policies with ambiguous KMS constraints, 3) audit log enrichment to include kms_key_id, kms_key_region, kms_requester_principal and policy_evaluation_id, 4) unit and integration tests covering policy evaluation, region mismatch flows and fallback behavior, 5) docs and operator migration guide describing configuration, rollback and backport steps. Checklist: - [x] RBAC engine changes implemented and unit tested - [x] Migration helper and CLI flag added - [x] Audit log schema updated and tested with observability pipeline - [x] End-to-end integration tests passing in perf-canary - [x] Docs and release notes added - [x] Security review completed Notes: this is intentionally conservative and defaults to "audit" mode for existing tenants. Operators must opt into enforcement via the admin console or feature flag. For Dedicated/Private deployments see private-installer note about requiring KMS endpoint whitelisting.
